¡Hola! We are the main community of Spanish students from the University of Cambridge. We organise social events regularly to meet other students from (or interested in) Spain and promote Spanish culture within the University. We also host academic events like speakers or panel discussions frequently during term time. Follow us on Facebook to keep up with our events!

Please contact us if you want to know more! We welcome everyone.

You can get your membership here: https://spanishsocmembership.getqpay.com
180 Degrees is the world’s largest student consultancy. By recruiting and training Cambridge students, we provide consulting services to socially conscious organisations and increase their impact.

180 Degrees Consulting is the world’s largest non-profit student-driven consultancy. Our mission is to strengthen the ability of socially conscious organisations to achieve high impact with social outcomes.

Through 180 Degrees Consulting university students are introduced to recognised consulting methodologies. We run various events throughout the year related to the combination of consulting and work for social and non-profit organisations. The highlight is our yearly flagship project where student consultants are able to interact with non-profit organisations using knowledge gained throughout the program and at university.

What do you gain from the projects?

- Real life consulting experience while studying at university
- Working directly with worthwhile organisations to identify and overcome specific challenges they are facing
- Contribute tangible impact to your communities and develop valuable life skills

You can find out more about us on our Facebook and our website. Feel free to drop us an email at cambridge.recruiting@180dc.org if you have any questions!

We aim to promote Scandinavian culture in Cambridge and serve our members by offering fun events for all! Traditional events include i.e. the Glöggfest, Sittnings, Fyraftensøl, and Formals!

claims.valueRaw:
We aim to promote Scandinavian culture in Cambridge and serve our members through offering relaxing and fun events for all! Traditional events include the Christmas Dinner, various Formal Hall exchanges, the annual Ambassadors' Dinner (formal dinner with Scandinavian ambassadors organized every other year in Cambridge and every other in Oxford) and watching the Eurovision event together, in addition to seminars, sports events and movie presentations.

Everybody is welcome to our events but our non-free events and society stash will have a members' price and a non-members' price, so we highly recommend you to buy a life-membership on our website!

Please do not hesitate to contact us on email or over facebook/messenger.

We can't wait to meet you!
